limitations: Posthoc correction motivated by the inspected calibration pilot boundary errors; not preregistered pilot evaluation.
Engineering diagnostics on calibration pilot only; checkpoint training exposure expected. No thresholds selected by best score. No new inference or likelihood calibration.
